name: Ministry of Digital Development and Information
aliases: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (previously MCI)

scam_info.sample: Government agencies will make calls using numbers that start with a common Government prefix, and these calls will display a recognisable Government caller name. The Singapore Police Force will pilot the use of the common prefix from 2 November 2026
scam_info.notes: Whole-of-government anti-scam hub covering MDDI, IMDA, CSA, GovTech and OGP measures. Jan-Jun 2026 stats: >70M scam calls blocked, 77,500 lines disrupted, 11M scam SMS blocked, >3.3M suspicious app installs blocked, >52,500 websites blocked via SPF orders, 39,700 more disrupted through industry, >31,600 monikers/ads disrupted. Also covers SIM-card limits (max 10 postpaid SIMs across telcos from 28 Feb 2026) and gov.sg sender ID stats (391M SMS sent). Aggregates and policy only, no IOCs.

Newsroom RSS via rel=alternate: 200 items (7 May to 22 Nov 2026), 4 scam-related (latest 1 Nov 2026 SPF single caller ID). The sitemap https://www.mddi.gov.sg/sitemap.xml (1,712 URLs, lastmod; bulk 2026-07-30 re-save) has 29 scam/phish/fake/spoof/sender-id slugs: PQ replies on +65 scam calls, overseas call blocking, NRIC-citing callers and local-number spoofing; joint-advisory-on-government-official-impersonation-scam; launch-of-gov-sg-single-sender-id; shutdown-of-anti-sms-spoofing-registry. item_count = sitemap keyword slugs. No IOCs.

notes: Parent of IMDA, GovTech, CSA and the gov.sg portal (SGDI). MDDI co-developed the SPF single caller ID (6000 0999) and will roll out a common government call prefix and caller name.
